hypothesis: Replace uniform recurrent-state mean pooling only in the frozen sequence representation with bounded corpus-IDF-weighted pooling, so states at tokens that occur in fewer unlabeled corpus molecules contribute more to the normalized embedding while the autoregressive policy itself remains unchanged.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

activation_observables.measurement: Use up to all 4,096 canonical-valid molecules in the unchanged deterministic heldout split, partitioned into fixed consecutive 64-molecule panels. Within each panel and excluding self matches, identify each molecule's five nearest cosine neighbors under (a) the Parent-equivalent uniform mean-pooled embedding and (b) the published corpus-IDF-pooled embedding. For each neighbor set, compute mean radius-2 count-Morgan Tanimoto similarity to the anchor molecule and overlap with that panel's five highest-Tanimoto graph neighbors. Report the pooled paired IDF-minus-Parent changes, every panel's changes, the fraction of anchors whose mean neighbor Tanimoto increases, the token document frequencies and final weight range and standard deviation, nonuniform-weight use and fallback counts, output width and finiteness, and maximum serialized-reload difference. Activation requires a finite nonuniform corpus weight vector used by run-mode sequence_embeddings, no width change, exact reload reproduction, and a positive pooled change in mean neighbor Tanimoto; graph-neighbor overlap is retained as corroborating evidence rather than a substitute activation criterion.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled training split must have nonuniform token document frequencies and enough occurrences of less-common vocabulary entries to estimate finite bounded weights; an effectively uniform corpus invokes no meaningful intervention.

Less-common token positions must carry molecular-neighborhood information that the Parent's uniform pool dilutes. The mechanism may not help when rare tokens are mostly syntactic noise or when common scaffolds and length-related coordinates contain the reward-relevant signal.

The relation between heldout graph-neighborhood coherence and downstream reward smoothness must transfer to de novo molecules within the same canonical tokenizer and corpus-supported policy distribution. Activity cliffs or objectives dominated by global shape can remain poorly represented even after the observable increases.

The mechanism changes only how already-trained recurrent states are pooled. Generator logits and ancestral support remain Parent-identical, so it does not address the Parent's parse failures, finite proposal support, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement numerical collapse.

The same vocabulary, BOS/EOS/padding semantics, GRU parameters, likelihood and sampling calls, finite normalized 512-dimensional output, and two-file artifact interface must remain usable unchanged by the surrogate, anchor, clone, and integration consumers.

This is distinct from n-d3657d86652a because it retains every embedding coordinate and reweights token states by corpus information instead of projecting out a length axis; it is distinct from n-f851988d522a and Mechanism Cluster c-9956bd4a51 because it keeps one canonical embedding and one real score per graph and never adds or marginalizes graph-equivalent labeled views. It also does not revisit refuted node n-dab88c5af357, because the terminal trained policy is retained rather than selecting among checkpoints.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the corpus document-frequency calculation yields a uniform, non-finite, or out-of-bounds vector, if the serialized weights are not used by run-mode sequence_embeddings, if the Parent fallback handles all audited rows, if any published embedding is non-finite or changes the 512-dimensional normalized interface, if artifact reload does not reproduce the IDF-pooled heldout embeddings, or if their pooled mean heldout count-Morgan neighbor similarity fails to increase over the paired Parent-equivalent uniform pool. If that neighborhood quantity increases but benchmark score does not, the content-weighted pooling mechanism activated without useful task transfer rather than failing to occur.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the Parent's corpus reservoir and split, vocabulary, GRU architecture and parameters, five-epoch next-token objective and optimizer, terminal checkpoint, forward logits, likelihood calculation, ancestral sampler, support audit, artifact filenames, canonicalization, and every run-mode Layer unchanged. During preparation, count in how many molecules of the unchanged training split each vocabulary token occurs and construct one finite weight per token as 1 + log((N + 1) / (document_frequency + 1)), capped at 4 and normalized over non-special vocabulary entries; assign padding weight zero and retain finite bounded weights for BOS, EOS, and UNK. Register this vector as a non-parameter policy buffer. Change only sequence_embeddings: compute the same recurrent states as the Parent, pool them using their aligned token weights divided by the finite per-sequence weight sum, and L2-normalize to the same 512-dimensional interface. If the serialized vector, a row's denominator, or its weighted norm is non-finite or effectively zero, use the exact Parent uniform mean-pool for that row and record the bounded fallback. On canonical-valid molecules from the existing heldout corpus split, compute paired Parent-equivalent and IDF-pooled embeddings and the registered neighborhood audit, then reload the two-file artifact and verify exact reproduction. Morgan fingerprints are diagnostic-only heldout references; neither they nor any corpus molecule enter the task-local observation table, proposal generation, or acquisition. No task identity, oracle score, randomized labeled view, or online update contributes to the weights.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace uniform recurrent-state mean pooling only in the frozen sequence representation with bounded corpus-IDF-weighted pooling, so states at tokens that occur in fewer unlabeled corpus molecules contribute more to the normalized embedding while the autoregressive policy itself remains unchanged.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf gives every non-padding recurrent state equal weight in its normalized 512-dimensional sequence embedding, so ubiquitous boundary and syntax positions contribute as much to GP distance as rarer atom, bond, ring, and stereochemical positions. Its downstream mechanics are operational across three seeds—all 450 surrogate fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation—but disposable optimization still lowers paired posterior-mean reward in 130 of 435 rounds and has pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift of only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only sibling n-d3657d86652a shows that this frozen geometry is consequential: removing one corpus-estimated length axis raises mean paired macro score by 0.02482218848232635, yet regresses seed 2 and the median_2 and zaleplon_mpo task means, so deleting a whole global coordinate can also discard useful chemistry. Node n-f851988d522a instead lowers in-table graph-equivalent disagreement by repeating labeled views but lowers seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakens expected-improvement lift. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore indiscriminate uniform pooling inside the offline single-view representation, not failed assimilation or a need to duplicate scored graphs.

applicability_conditions: The refutation applies to the observed 245,904-row unlabeled training splits, preparation seeds 0 through 2, seed-specific 79-, 78-, and 80-token vocabularies, unchanged five-epoch GRU states, and the exact capped-and-non-special-normalized corpus document-frequency transform.

The corpus supplies the prerequisite nonuniform document frequencies and finite bounded weights in every seed, so absence of intervention is not the explanation: each vector is nonuniform, every nonpadding entry is positive and at most 1.159786343574524 after normalization, and every audited row uses it without fallback.

The neighborhood conclusion is supported on 12,287 canonical-valid deterministic heldout molecules under 192 consecutive panels and five within-panel neighbors. It establishes a negative pooled change for radius-2 2,048-coordinate count-Morgan Tanimoto and corroborating graph-neighbor overlap, not a universal statement about every chemical similarity definition or panel partition.

The frozen artifact and downstream interface remain applicable at width 512: all embeddings are finite, three serialized reloads are bit-exact, each task log binds to the expected weighted-state hash, and all fifteen objective sessions complete their full budgets.

Preparation remains corpus-only and task agnostic in the observed implementation. Document frequencies derive solely from the inherited training split, Morgan fingerprints are used only by the heldout audit, and no task identity, oracle score, labeled view, or online update changes the weights.

A positive-use claim would additionally require a corpus and recurrent representation in which less-common aligned token states carry neighborhood information that uniform pooling dilutes. That condition is not supported here; the three replicated negative deltas show it cannot be assumed merely from nonuniform token frequencies.

The intervention leaves generator logits, likelihood, ancestral support, the task-local observation table, true-reward anchor updates, disposable-clone optimization, and expected-improvement acquisition unchanged. It therefore remains irrelevant to parse failures, absent proposal support, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement numerical collapse.

possible_failure_causes: The necessary content-locality premise failed on the registered proxy. All three pooled Tanimoto deltas are negative, 121/192 panel deltas are negative, and fewer than 31% of anchors improve in any seed, so the result is replicated rather than driven by one preparation or one panel.

The capped transform collapses many genuinely different rare tokens to the same maximum final weight: the ledgers show most bracketed atoms, high ring indices, and other low-frequency entries at approximately 1.155 to 1.160. It therefore separates ubiquitous tokens from a broad rare-token bucket but preserves little frequency resolution within that bucket.

The strongest downweighting applies not only to uninformative boundaries but also to chemically structural positions: BOS/EOS and ubiquitous C, c, parentheses, ring digit 1, N, O, and '=' receive weights near 0.289 to 0.344, while rare syntax receives the maximum. Common scaffold and branching information may consequently be suppressed more than noise.

A GRU state already summarizes the entire preceding prefix, so the document frequency of the token aligned to a state is not a direct measure of the chemical information contained in that state. Rare-position weighting can amplify prefix history at syntactically unusual locations without improving molecular locality.

The downstream scores do not rescue the failed activation criterion. Candidate val_scores 0.573985723633258, 0.575596531270029, and 0.501627162617229 compare with paired Parent scores 0.513626533890974, 0.558308002112387, and 0.575798548411393, producing mixed seed changes +0.060359189742283936, +0.017288529157642007, and -0.07417138579416405 and a mean change +0.0011587777019206325, below the preregistered +0.002 minimum. These task outcomes are not evidence that the required heldout behavior occurred.

The radius-2 count-Morgan diagnostic and consecutive 64-molecule competition are deliberately local proxies. They decisively refute this Research Intent as registered, but they do not show whether the same weighting could alter a global-neighbor metric, another fingerprint radius, stereochemical similarity, or a particular reward surface in a different direction.

Both fallback guards remained unexercised: all 12,287 audit rows used the weighted path before and after reload. The evidence establishes that fallback did not cause the regression, but it does not empirically establish behavior for a future nonfinite vector, zero denominator, or near-zero weighted norm.

Preparation remains corpus-only and task agnostic in the observed implementation. Document frequencies derive solely from the inherited training split, Morgan fingerprints are used only by the heldout audit, and no task identity, oracle score, labeled view, or online update changes the weights.

A positive-use claim would additionally require a corpus and recurrent representation in which less-common aligned token states carry neighborhood information that uniform pooling dilutes. That condition is not supported here; the three replicated negative deltas show it cannot be assumed merely from nonuniform token frequencies.

The intervention leaves generator logits, likelihood, ancestral support, the task-local observation table, true-reward anchor updates, disposable-clone optimization, and expected-improvement acquisition unchanged. It therefore remains irrelevant to parse failures, absent proposal support, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement numerical collapse.

possible_failure_causes: The necessary content-locality premise failed on the registered proxy. All three pooled Tanimoto deltas are negative, 121/192 panel deltas are negative, and fewer than 31% of anchors improve in any seed, so the result is replicated rather than driven by one preparation or one panel.

The capped transform collapses many genuinely different rare tokens to the same maximum final weight: the ledgers show most bracketed atoms, high ring indices, and other low-frequency entries at approximately 1.155 to 1.160. It therefore separates ubiquitous tokens from a broad rare-token bucket but preserves little frequency resolution within that bucket.

The strongest downweighting applies not only to uninformative boundaries but also to chemically structural positions: BOS/EOS and ubiquitous C, c, parentheses, ring digit 1, N, O, and '=' receive weights near 0.289 to 0.344, while rare syntax receives the maximum. Common scaffold and branching information may consequently be suppressed more than noise.

A GRU state already summarizes the entire preceding prefix, so the document frequency of the token aligned to a state is not a direct measure of the chemical information contained in that state. Rare-position weighting can amplify prefix history at syntactically unusual locations without improving molecular locality.

The downstream scores do not rescue the failed activation criterion. Candidate val_scores 0.573985723633258, 0.575596531270029, and 0.501627162617229 compare with paired Parent scores 0.513626533890974, 0.558308002112387, and 0.575798548411393, producing mixed seed changes +0.060359189742283936, +0.017288529157642007, and -0.07417138579416405 and a mean change +0.0011587777019206325, below the preregistered +0.002 minimum. These task outcomes are not evidence that the required heldout behavior occurred.

The radius-2 count-Morgan diagnostic and consecutive 64-molecule competition are deliberately local proxies. They decisively refute this Research Intent as registered, but they do not show whether the same weighting could alter a global-neighbor metric, another fingerprint radius, stereochemical similarity, or a particular reward surface in a different direction.

Both fallback guards remained unexercised: all 12,287 audit rows used the weighted path before and after reload. The evidence establishes that fallback did not cause the regression, but it does not empirically establish behavior for a future nonfinite vector, zero denominator, or near-zero weighted norm.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled training split must have nonuniform token document frequencies and enough occurrences of less-common vocabulary entries to estimate finite bounded weights; an effectively uniform corpus invokes no meaningful intervention.

Less-common token positions must carry molecular-neighborhood information that the Parent's uniform pool dilutes. The mechanism may not help when rare tokens are mostly syntactic noise or when common scaffolds and length-related coordinates contain the reward-relevant signal.

The relation between heldout graph-neighborhood coherence and downstream reward smoothness must transfer to de novo molecules within the same canonical tokenizer and corpus-supported policy distribution. Activity cliffs or objectives dominated by global shape can remain poorly represented even after the observable increases.

The mechanism changes only how already-trained recurrent states are pooled. Generator logits and ancestral support remain Parent-identical, so it does not address the Parent's parse failures, finite proposal support, true-anchor ordering failures, or late expected-improvement numerical collapse.

The same vocabulary, BOS/EOS/padding semantics, GRU parameters, likelihood and sampling calls, finite normalized 512-dimensional output, and two-file artifact interface must remain usable unchanged by the surrogate, anchor, clone, and integration consumers.

This is distinct from n-d3657d86652a because it retains every embedding coordinate and reweights token states by corpus information instead of projecting out a length axis; it is distinct from n-f851988d522a and Mechanism Cluster c-9956bd4a51 because it keeps one canonical embedding and one real score per graph and never adds or marginalizes graph-equivalent labeled views. It also does not revisit refuted node n-dab88c5af357, because the terminal trained policy is retained rather than selecting among checkpoints.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the corpus document-frequency calculation yields a uniform, non-finite, or out-of-bounds vector, if the serialized weights are not used by run-mode sequence_embeddings, if the Parent fallback handles all audited rows, if any published embedding is non-finite or changes the 512-dimensional normalized interface, if artifact reload does not reproduce the IDF-pooled heldout embeddings, or if their pooled mean heldout count-Morgan neighbor similarity fails to increase over the paired Parent-equivalent uniform pool. If that neighborhood quantity increases but benchmark score does not, the content-weighted pooling mechanism activated without useful task transfer rather than failing to occur.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the Parent's corpus reservoir and split, vocabulary, GRU architecture and parameters, five-epoch next-token objective and optimizer, terminal checkpoint, forward logits, likelihood calculation, ancestral sampler, support audit, artifact filenames, canonicalization, and every run-mode Layer unchanged. During preparation, count in how many molecules of the unchanged training split each vocabulary token occurs and construct one finite weight per token as 1 + log((N + 1) / (document_frequency + 1)), capped at 4 and normalized over non-special vocabulary entries; assign padding weight zero and retain finite bounded weights for BOS, EOS, and UNK. Register this vector as a non-parameter policy buffer. Change only sequence_embeddings: compute the same recurrent states as the Parent, pool them using their aligned token weights divided by the finite per-sequence weight sum, and L2-normalize to the same 512-dimensional interface. If the serialized vector, a row's denominator, or its weighted norm is non-finite or effectively zero, use the exact Parent uniform mean-pool for that row and record the bounded fallback. On canonical-valid molecules from the existing heldout corpus split, compute paired Parent-equivalent and IDF-pooled embeddings and the registered neighborhood audit, then reload the two-file artifact and verify exact reproduction. Morgan fingerprints are diagnostic-only heldout references; neither they nor any corpus molecule enter the task-local observation table, proposal generation, or acquisition. No task identity, oracle score, randomized labeled view, or online update contributes to the weights.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace uniform recurrent-state mean pooling only in the frozen sequence representation with bounded corpus-IDF-weighted pooling, so states at tokens that occur in fewer unlabeled corpus molecules contribute more to the normalized embedding while the autoregressive policy itself remains unchanged.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf gives every non-padding recurrent state equal weight in its normalized 512-dimensional sequence embedding, so ubiquitous boundary and syntax positions contribute as much to GP distance as rarer atom, bond, ring, and stereochemical positions. Its downstream mechanics are operational across three seeds—all 450 surrogate fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation—but disposable optimization still lowers paired posterior-mean reward in 130 of 435 rounds and has pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift of only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only sibling n-d3657d86652a shows that this frozen geometry is consequential: removing one corpus-estimated length axis raises mean paired macro score by 0.02482218848232635, yet regresses seed 2 and the median_2 and zaleplon_mpo task means, so deleting a whole global coordinate can also discard useful chemistry. Node n-f851988d522a instead lowers in-table graph-equivalent disagreement by repeating labeled views but lowers seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakens expected-improvement lift. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore indiscriminate uniform pooling inside the offline single-view representation, not failed assimilation or a need to duplicate scored graphs.
